core.title: Declare at least one SMOKE acceptance on every DESIRED OUTCOME
core.given: Any DESIRED OUTCOME plan artifact in the plan: new, edited, or existing and untouched
core.when: the planner authors, edits, reviews or validates it
core.then: Ensure the DESIRED OUTCOME declares at least one acceptance whose identity URN has the profile's smoke-acceptance URN shape and whose identity phase is SMOKE.
prefer: Make the SMOKE acceptance the explicit real-infrastructure check between GREEN and REFACTOR.

Repair: resolve the DESIRED OUTCOME URN with the profile's URN resolver, open the DESIRED OUTCOME plan artifact at the reported violation location, add the SMOKE acceptance, then re-run the rule's check until it is clean.
avoid: DESIRED OUTCOMES with no declared real-infrastructure (SMOKE) check.
Assuming downstream SMOKE tests suffice without declaring the acceptance in the DESIRED OUTCOME.
Suppressing a DESIRED OUTCOME that exercises real infrastructure, or suppressing without an UNTIL expiry.
unless: The DESIRED OUTCOME is genuinely docs-only / metadata with no real infrastructure to verify: put the profile's time-boxed suppression marker for this rule on the DESIRED OUTCOME's own URN declaration line, with the UNTIL date set to today + 90 days.
core.why: Tester rules only check coverage of SMOKE tests that exist; without a declared SMOKE acceptance the lifecycle has no explicit real-infrastructure verification before REFACTOR.
evidence: Every DESIRED OUTCOME plan artifact has at least one acceptance whose identity URN matches the smoke-acceptance URN shape and whose identity phase is SMOKE, or a valid suppression per unless[0]: the DESIRED OUTCOME is genuinely docs-only/metadata with no real infrastructure to verify, and the suppression marker for this rule sits on its URN declaration line with an unexpired UNTIL date set to today + 90 days when added.
The stack's check for this rule passes (reports no DESIRED OUTCOME without a SMOKE acceptance).
verification: The check counts, per DESIRED OUTCOME, the acceptance URNs carrying the SMOKE harness token; a violation is a count of 0. It applies to every DESIRED OUTCOME plan artifact, edited or not, and reports the location as the DESIRED OUTCOME artifact path and line.
A smoke acceptance is an acceptance URN carrying the SMOKE harness token, in the smoke-acceptance URN shape, with phase SMOKE.

A suppression is honoured only as the inline, time-boxed suppression marker for this rule placed on the DESIRED OUTCOME's URN declaration line; the instruction is to set UNTIL to today + 90 days. Whether the DESIRED OUTCOME is genuinely docs-only/metadata is a judgement the check does not make.
The check is realized by a stack-specific validator; its id and command are realization details.

values: this rule's check reports a DESIRED OUTCOME with 0 SMOKE acceptance URNs

fires: A planner creates a new DESIRED OUTCOME whose acceptances are all non-SMOKE harness types.
A planner edits a DESIRED OUTCOME and removes or renames its only SMOKE acceptance.
A planner reviews or validates an existing, unedited DESIRED OUTCOME that declares no SMOKE acceptance.
The rule's check reports a DESIRED OUTCOME declaring 0 acceptance URNs with the SMOKE harness token.
doesNotFire: A DESIRED OUTCOME already declares an acceptance with a smoke-acceptance URN and identity phase SMOKE.
A genuinely docs-only / metadata DESIRED OUTCOME with no real infrastructure carries an unexpired suppression marker for this rule on its URN declaration line.
Plan artifacts that are not DESIRED OUTCOMES (product capability manifests, docs).

neutralityNotes: DESIRED OUTCOME, acceptance, SMOKE/GREEN/REFACTOR phases and the identity URN/phase of an acceptance are ATDD methodology concepts, not stack specifics, so they stay in the core. The 'today + 90 days' UNTIL policy is rule policy and stays in the core; only the marker syntax comes from the profile. Severity 3 / disposition suppress-and-clean (from bun.json audit) are recorded in core verification.
